source.description:
PROBLEM: Amendment section 5 and acceptance 8-9 want a command-driven Specialist inspector that opens a native transcript or feed overlay reusing the sp-terminal-overlay UX over the native AgentSession, with no legacy sp feed subprocess for native sessions. The operator deliberately deferred this: the ui.custom path hard-locks the TUI in this pi version even after the flicker fix (unitAI-z49s2) and the string-row fix (unitAI-dygdq), so unitAI-nmxhg removed the inspector mount and /fleet inspect prints a text report instead.

SCOPE (rough): TBD after pi ui.custom reliability is proven. Likely the openFleetInspector path in config/pi-extensions/specialist-subagents/index.mjs plus an overlay component consuming host inspect transcript and events, plus tests. Needs exploration before promotion.

NON_GOALS: Everything until the ui.custom path is trustworthy; keyboard attach stays with xtrm-tui per the amendment.

CONSTRAINTS: TBD at promotion. Promotion requires re-reading current pi extension API behavior and the amendment.

VALIDATION: TBD at promotion; at minimum a flicker-free live inspector session plus unit coverage.

OUTPUT: TBD at promotion.

SCRUTINY: low
source.title: Deferred: native Specialist transcript-feed overlay for the stock Pi extension (amendment section 5)
